title: ctrl+o verbose toggle renders the tool block three different ways and shows less detail when verbose
observed: Default: 'Read package.json → { "name": … … +5 lines (ctrl+o to expand)'. After ctrl+o (verbose): 'Read /tmp/…/package.json → Read 9 lines' — the file preview is gone — plus a stray right-aligned '7:00 PM faux/faux-1' row, and no blank row between the you block and the kiln label. After ctrl+o again: '  Read 1 file' — a third rendering, not the original.
expected: ctrl+o expands the collapsed output in place (all 9 lines) and toggling back restores exactly the original rendering; block spacing stays one blank row; any per-message meta sits on the label rule, not a row of its own.

fix.note: Known gap: a replayed tool block's meta (approved · 4.1s) is empty; the session log does not persist it.
